messages:
alex: thanks everyone for staying after the all-hands — quick follow-ups from the security segment, want to capture questions and owners here

maria (Head of Security): great, i'll answer the backlog on SOC2/ISO, VPC isolation, audit logs, and KMS BYOK timelines. dropping short bullets.

jordan (PM): is SOC2 Type II scoping still on track for next quarter?

maria (Head of Security): yes scope confirmed for the hosted API + dedicated control plane. target: attestation window in Q3, audit readiness in early Q4. still room for minor scope changes.

ana: (typo) ana (Security Eng): one note — private deployments (customer-managed VPC) need explicit network egress controls documented for auditors. we'll post a template.

sam (Infra): for Private we plan a private control plane option: customers can choose VPC-peering or AWS PrivateLink. ETA: rolling pilot in two sprints.

jordan (PM): perfect — can we get a short checklist so sales knows what to ask for during demos?

maria (Head of Security): yes, checklist + RACI will be posted to the handbook by next Tue. @jordan assigning to ana for initial draft.

eng-oncall: question on audit logs — default retention today is 90d for console events, is that changing for Dedicated/Private?

maria (Head of Security): default stays 90d for hosted; Dedicated/Private customers can configure retention and forward logs to their S3/ELK. Enterprise add-on for extended retention 1y+.

eng-oncall: and is there a recommended forwarder? we had requests for Splunk/Sumologic connectors.

ana: (ana): we have a log-forwarder Lambda + Kinesis pattern. example config snippet we use for customers:
```
# forward logs to customer S3
aws s3 cp /var/log/redwood-audit s3://customer-audit-bucket/ --recursive
# or send via Kinesis
./shipper --input /var/log/redwood-audit --output kinesis://prod-audit-stream
```

maria (Head of Security): auditors also want integrity and tamper-evidence. we recommend customers enable object-lock on S3 or push to an external SIEM with immutability options.

jordan (PM): KMS BYOK ask from the field — what's the timeline for a simple customer key import flow?

maria (Head of Security): BYOK MVP: Q4 planning. scope: import keys for Hosted (managed-key placeholders) + detailed instructions for Private. HSM/BYOK with HSM-backed key policies is later.

sam (Infra): technical note: we will support wrapping keys with our key-encryption-key and allow customer-managed KEKs in the private control plane.

liz (CEO): thanks for the clarity — can we get two slides for exec recap (timeline + customer impact)?

maria (Head of Security): yes. i'll add slides and share with @liz, @jordan by Friday.

alex: action items i'm capturing: 1) ana to draft VPC/egress checklist (due Tue), 2) ana + eng-oncall to publish log-forwarder examples to handbook (due Wed), 3) maria to publish SOC2 roadmap slides (due Fri), 4) sam to start Private control plane pilot notes (owner sam, due next sprint). react here to claim. :thumbsup:

ana: (ana): claiming checklist + log examples :raised_hands:

sam (Infra): claiming pilot notes :white_check_mark:

jordan (PM): i'll coordinate slides with maria and sales talking points.

devops-bot: deploy 1861.234 -> infra/prod succeeded :rocket:

alex: thanks all — i'll close this thread after verifying the handbook links are up. if anything urgent ping me or drop in #security.

maria (Head of Security): one last thing — short security office hour next Wed 11:00 PT for any deep-dive on SOC2/ISO artifacts. RSVP in the calendar.

liz (CEO): appreciate the follow-up, team.
